entry.condition: Enter only on the original white-label TDI sharkfin signal: fast TDI curls upward while still below 32 for a buy, or curls downward while still above 68 for a sell/reduce signal.
entry.default_threshold: Long: 3-bar fast-TDI sharkfin below 32. Sell/reduce: 3-bar fast-TDI sharkfin above 68.

confirmation.condition: The fast TDI must form the original three-bar sharkfin sequence. Turquoise crosses are wait markers and are not trade signals.
confirmation.default_threshold: White-label sharkfin only; no TDI Bollinger-band triggers.

take_profit.condition: Backtest/live strategy statistics use a 1.0% price take-profit for the white-label signal.

stop_loss.condition: Backtest/live strategy statistics use a 0.5% price stop-loss for the white-label signal.

risk_governor.spot_wallet_rule: Long buys USDT to selected token. Sell/exit reduces selected token to USDT only if the wallet already holds the token.
